blue.title: Back Blue (Blue Bell)
blue.description: The blue of the back and wings of the blue-and-yellow macaw, the brand color. In the theme, it colors keywords, tags, and the status bar.

green.title: Crown Green (Yellow Green)
green.description: The green at the top of the head, where the green feather meets the blue. In the theme, it colors types (classes, interfaces) and informational messages.

sky.title: Wing Reflection (Sky Reflection)
sky.description: The light blue that light draws from the wing feathers. In the theme, it colors strings and signals success, like added lines in Git.

gold.title: Chest Gold (Goldenrod)
gold.description: The gold of the chest, the accent color. In the theme, it colors functions and the cursor, which is where your gaze rests while you type.

orange.title: Neck Orange (Tiger Orange)
orange.description: The warm transition of the neck, between the chest and the wings. In the theme, it colors numbers, constants, parameters, and warnings.

red.title: Scarlet Macaw Red (Flag Red)
red.description: The red that visits the theme only for what demands attention: errors, invalid code, and removed lines. In text we use a lighter shade of it (red.500) to ensure readability against the dark background.

glow.title: Yellow Wing Band (Golden Glow)
glow.description: The vivid yellow of the band on the scarlet macaw's wings, also found in the golden trumpet tree. It is a rare accent: decorators, escapes, and regular expressions.

light.title: Feather White
light.description: The white facial mask, streaked with black. In the theme it is the main text: a slightly bluish white, with a contrast ratio of 15.7:1 against the background.

dark.title: Beak Black
dark.description: The black of the beak and the facial stripes. In the theme it is the editor background: a black with a slight feather-blue tint, which lets the bird's colors shine.
